# Google Play — Upcoming Policy Deadlines

> Source: [Upcoming Android and Google Play deadlines](https://developer.android.com/distribute/play-policies) · authoritative dates: [Play Console Policy Deadlines](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/table/12921780)
> **Checked by policy-sync:** 2026-11-09

| Date | Policy update |
|------|---------------|
| 2026-08-26 | We're expanding our Families Policy Requirements policy to prohibit developers of anonymous chat apps from targeting children. |
| 2026-08-26 | We're expanding our Age-Restricted Content and Functionality policy to apply to anonymous chat and random chat apps. |
| 2026-08-26 | We're expanding our Child Safety Standards policy to apply to anonymous chat and random chat apps. |
| 2026-09-30 | Android developer verification goes into effect. Apps from participating stores in Brazil, Indonesia, Singapore, and Thailand must be registered by a verified developer to be installed on certified Android devices. We're also updating Play Console requirements to meet Android developer verification requirements. While 99% of apps on Play have been registered automatically, you should check your Play Console Home page to register any remaining apps to avoid global removal from Google Play and ensure a seamless user installation experience. |
| 2027-01-27 | We're removing geofencing as an approved foreground services use case . Developers can instead use the Geofence API for this use case. |
| 2027-01-27 | We're introducing the Contacts Permission policy to govern broad access of users' contacts. Apps that don't need broad access must use the Android Contact Picker , a more secure, easy-to-integrate alternative that minimizes data collection and improves user safety. |
| 2027-01-27 | We're updating the Location Permissions policy. To meet our minimum scope requirements, apps targeting Android 17 (API 37+) must now implement the Android location button for one-time or infrequent precise location requests. If your app's core functionality requires broader ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION access, you must submit a Play Console declaration justifying why the location button or coarse location is insufficient. |
| 2027-01-27 | Our SMS and Call Log Permissions policy will no longer permit account verification via phone call as a use case for the READ_CALL_LOG permission. To securely verify accounts without requiring sensitive app permissions, use the Digital Credentials API instead, either directly or through a verification provider built upon it, or the SMS Retriever API . Please refer to this page for additional alternative APIs. |
| 2027-01-27 | Subscriptions with ongoing eligibility-based discounts , such as student plans, must clearly disclose eligibility criteria, the verification process, and post-eligibility pricing and benefit changes. |
| 2027-04-14 | AppFunctions API : Developers building AppFunctions must comply with all existing Google Play policies. AppFunctions are strictly prohibited from deceiving or manipulating AI agents, bypassing security controls, or interfering with other applications. |
| 2027-08-25 | Local Network Permission : This permission is restricted to apps that need it for core functionality when device pickers are insufficient. Apps targeting Android 17 or higher (API 37+) must submit a Play Console declaration to use this permission. |
| 2027-08-25 | Manage Contacts Permission : This permission is restricted to apps that need it for core functionality when system pickers are insufficient and apps must submit a Play Console declaration to use it. All other apps must use narrowly scoped platform intents. |
